shortDescription: Configures Service Profiles from templates on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: description
options.description: Optional The Description of the service profile

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the service profile. This name can be between 2 and 32 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). This name must be unique across all service profiles and service profile templates within the same organization.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: power_state
options.description: The power state to be applied when this service profile is associated with a server. If no value is provided, the power_state for the service profile will not be modified.

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: source_template
options.description: The name of the service profile template used to create this serivce profile.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify Service Profiles are present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify Service Profiles are absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: user_label
options.description: The User Label you want to assign to this service profile.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.
